_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: find a few letters' values to write a code or match one; 2: a few letters' values, then one more step (a product, a square, or a total of zero); 3: every letter of four options worked out and compared; 4: letters written as row-and-column pairs across two matrices. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
